title: tradescantia zebrina var. flocculosa
intro: Tradescantia zebrina var. flocculosa, commonly known as Silver Inch Plant or Velvet Leaf, is a popular houseplant known for its attractive, fuzzy leaves with a silvery-green color. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Tradescantia zebrina var. flocculosa include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
